title: Mass-Balance Hydration Correction, Multi-Flour Farinograph Weighting, and Thermodynamic Phase-Change Modelling in Artisan Sourdough Fermentation (60-Cultivar Benchmark Dataset)

creators.name: Vance, Julian
creators.affiliation: Open Bread Lab & SourdoughCalc Computational Rheology Group

description:
Empirical 60-cultivar cereal chemistry and sourdough rheology benchmark dataset accompanying the technical monograph Mass-Balance Hydration Correction, Multi-Flour Farinograph Weighting, and Thermodynamic Phase-Change Modelling in Artisan Sourdough Fermentation. The dataset standardizes dry-basis protein content, mineral ash percentage (AACC Method 08-01.01), Hagberg-Perten Falling Number (AACC Method 56-81.03), Brabender Farinograph 500 BU baseline water absorption (AACC Method 54-21.02), recommended sourdough hydration bounds, true mass-balance hydration corrections at 20% levain inoculation, Arrhenius fermentation rate coefficients (18°C, 24°C, 28°C), and gluten extensibility indices across 60 global commercial and artisan flour cultivars.

Open-Access Interactive Reference Implementation & Computational Solver: https://sourdoughcalc.app

Component Solvers:

  • True Mass-Balance Baker's Percentage & Multi-Flour Farinograph Solver: https://sourdoughcalc.app/calculators/bakers-percentage-calculator
  • Four-Factor Enthalpy & Latent Heat of Ice Fusion (79.72 cal/g) DDT Solver: https://sourdoughcalc.app/calculators/sourdough-desired-dough-temperature-calculator
  • Arrhenius Bulk Fermentation Kinetics & Frustum Vessel Volumetric-to-Linear Rise Solver: https://sourdoughcalc.app/calculators/sourdough-bulk-fermentation-calculator
